instagram.caption:
Your 2FA text codes can be stolen without anyone touching your phone 📱

In a SIM swap, a criminal convinces your carrier to move your number to their SIM, then receives your text-message login codes. Authenticator apps, security keys and passkeys are stronger. Move your email first, since it can reset other accounts, and ask your carrier about a port-out PIN or number lock.

Set this up tonight, and share it with someone who uses text codes.

#cybersecurity #simswap #techtips #privacy #aitools
instagram.first_comment: Are you still using text codes for your email?
